questions.question: Which country features the highest number of time zones within its national territory and dependencies?
questions.fun_fact: France spans 12 different time zones worldwide due to its various overseas departments and territories.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse organelle within eukaryotic cells responsible for generating most of the chemical energy needed?
questions.fun_fact: Mitochondria contain their own independent DNA that is distinct from the nuclear DNA of the cell.

questions.question: The Seven Years' War, fought in the mid-18th century, primarily involved a global conflict between which two main rival colonial powers?
questions.fun_fact: Winston Churchill famously referred to the Seven Years' War as the first true 'world war'.

questions.question: Which 1999 science fiction action film popularized the visual effect known as 'bullet time'?
questions.fun_fact: The iconic bullet-time sequence in The Matrix utilized an array of still cameras surrounding the actors to create a frozen-time effect.

questions.question: What is the primary starch ingredient used to make traditional Japanese mochi?
questions.fun_fact: Despite being called glutinous rice, mochi rice does not actually contain gluten.

questions.question: What unique physical characteristic distinguishes a male platypus from almost all other modern mammals?
options: It has a prehensile tail used for grasping branches.
It can change its fur color for camouflage.
It possesses venomous spurs on its hind legs.
questions.fun_fact: The venom from a male platypus's ankle spurs is powerful enough to cause severe pain in humans, though it is not normally fatal.

questions.question: In international field hockey, how many players are on the pitch for a single team during regulation play, including the goalkeeper?
questions.fun_fact: Field hockey is one of the oldest team sports in the world, with historical records of similar stick-and-ball games dating back to ancient Greece and Egypt.

questions.question: What linguistic term is used to describe words that sound identical when pronounced, but have different meanings and sometimes different spellings?
questions.fun_fact: The English language is particularly rich in homophones due to its complex history of borrowing words from many different languages.

questions.question: Which dwarf planet, located in the Kuiper Belt, is famous for possessing a giant, heart-shaped glacier officially named Tombaugh Regio?
questions.fun_fact: Tombaugh Regio on Pluto is named in honor of Clyde Tombaugh, the American astronomer who discovered Pluto in 1930.

questions.question: The Code of Hammurabi, one of the oldest deciphered writings of significant length in the world, originated from which ancient civilization?
questions.fun_fact: Inscribed on a massive basalt stele, the Code of Hammurabi is famous for its strict legal punishments governed by the rule of 'an eye for an eye'.
